name: Cloudflare Workflows Free
free_limit: Workers Free includes 3,000 Workflow steps/day and 1 GB-month of state storage; invocations share the Workers Free requests quota
watch_out: Workflow steps, state storage, Worker invocations and CPU are separate usage dimensions; 10 ms CPU per invocation on Free and the Workers Free daily request cap apply. Default completed/errored workflow state retention is 3 days. Workflow sleeps/waits do not consume CPU, and Workflows billing began August 10, 2026; Paid has separate metered charges.
